cases.name: Silvia Gabriella "Gaby" Vilchez
cases.about:
Silvia, who was known among her loved ones as "Gaby," was a beloved member of her local church community. "If you ever got to know her a little bit, your life was always enriched,” Lewis Chapel Church of God Pastor Jeff Smith told Local 3 News. “She was the type of person who doesn't leave you the same or empty whenever you see her the next time. It's a joy."

Her nephew said she had brought her son to the U.S. to give him a better life.
cases.relationship: Husband; Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative: On 10/30/2025, investigators located her charred remains in the backyard fire pit area.
